install.title: Add to Home Screen
install.intro: Install the app so it opens full-screen, like a real app, and works offline.
install.installed: The app is already installed on this device.
install.androidSteps: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right, then tap “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
install.ios2: Tap the Share button (a square with an arrow pointing up) at the bottom of the screen.
install.ios3: Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
install.ios4: Tap “Add” at the top right. The app icon now appears on your Home Screen.

admin.intro: Only these emails can log in. Add an email, then create the matching account in Firebase Authentication (or let the user use “Forgot password?” after you create it).

help.title: Help
help.body1: Pick a learner, choose a topic, then play. Every activity has a Listen button that reads the instructions aloud.
help.body2: Stars show how well you did: 3 stars for 80% or more, 2 stars for 50% or more.
help.body3: Scores are saved for each learner. Parents and teachers can see them under Scores.
help.body4: Need help with your account? Contact us on WhatsApp.
